user.title: Add a child
user.description: Kerb models what you want, not what any vendor offers. Start with the child. No date of birth is stored, only an age band.

device.title: Add a device for {child}
device.description: Pick the existing Home Assistant entities that can stop this device. Network blocking is the recommended default. Power is blunt and must be opted in. Manual means you act in the vendor app and press done. Devices added so far: {count}.

data.power_opt_in: Allow Kerb to cut power to this device

data.in_use_entity: Entity that is on, playing or home while the device is in use
data.manual: Manual: ask me to act in the vendor app and wait for done
data.add_another: Add another device after this one

guardians.title: Guardians and PIN
guardians.description: Only guardians may lock, unlock and grant from the dashboard. Automations are trusted. The PIN is optional and applies to everyone.
